title: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment
what_it_is: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment

sections.label: Climate adaptation and coastal protection
sections.summary: MSE will develop a National Adaptation Plan, a heat resilience strategy, and site-specific coastal protection studies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: MSE will develop Singapore’s inaugural National Adaptation Plan (NAP) that articulates targeted strategies to address physical risks and other impacts of climate change.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: MSE will develop a whole-of-Government integrated strategy for heat resilience, in partnership with businesses, academia and community.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To prepare for rising sea levels, MSE is undertaking site-specific studies across our coastline to identify and construct the most fit-for-purpose multi-functional coastal protection measures.

sections.label: Food resilience and carbon tax
sections.summary: MSE will diversify food imports, build stockpiles, help local agri-food scale up, and administer the carbon tax for net zero 2050.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: MSE will enhance our food supply resilience by continuing to diversify our food import sources, build up our stockpile of essential food items and help our local agri-food industry scale up and become more productive and climate-resilient.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Singapore is committed to achieving net zero emissions by 2050.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To support our decarbonisation journey, MSE administers the carbon tax, a key enabler which complements other mitigation measures, by sending an economy-wide price signal to help businesses plan and internalise the cost of carbon emissions.

sections.label: Long-term water infrastructure investment
sections.summary: MSE will continue long-term planning and investment in water infrastructure as demand is expected to almost double by 2065.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: MSE will continue to plan long-term and invest in our water infrastructure, as water demand is expected to almost double by 2065, in line with our economic and population growth.

sections.label: Hawker centre upgrading and building
sections.summary: The Government will invest up to $1 billion to upgrade existing hawker centres and build five new ones over 20 to 30 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To support the provision of affordable food options, the Government will invest up to $1 billion to upgrade existing hawker centres and build five new ones over the next 20 to 30 years.
